We eliminate the operational gap between static BIM Execution Plans and dynamic model execution, ensuring flawless public tender deliveries.

We bridge the gap between static contracts and your 3D geometry. Our engines translate rigid EIR mandates and strict ISO 19650 and UNI 11337 protocols into dynamic execution rules, instantly auditing your models to guarantee zero-error project delivery.

Eliminate hundreds of billable hours wasted on manual data entry. Our AI writes and executes secure, native Revit API scripts to autonomously inject and standardize thousands of metadata fields, cutting coordination time from days to seconds.

### \_ EXECUTION PIPELINE

## The Algorithmic Pipeline: From Contract to Code.

We do not output theoretical advice. Our infrastructure translates rigid contractual demands directly into executable C# and Python logic within your BIM environment.

01

### Contextual Knowledge Retrieval (RAG)

The system parses your static BIM Execution Plans (BEP) and strict ISO 19650 mandates, retrieving exact compliance rules from our structured Vector Databases.

02

### Autonomous Logic Generation

Our isolated AI engines dynamically write optimized Python and native C# scripts tailored to your specific facility requirements, bypassing manual data entry entirely.

03

### Secure API Execution

The generated logic fuses directly with the native Revit API, autonomously processing thousands of metadata fields and geometric parameters in milliseconds.

04

### Deterministic Validation (Human-in-the-loop)

Every automated action is strictly audited against the initial contractual rules. Changes are executed within safe, rollback-protected transactions to guarantee 100% zero-error deliverables.

### // CORE ENGINEERING OUTCOMES

### Algorithmic Processing Speed

Replace hundreds of manual engineering hours with instantaneous Python and C# script execution. Whether we manage the project or empower your team, we mathematically compress complex BIM workflows that traditionally consume weeks into a matter of hours.

### Deterministic Accuracy

Eliminate costly human error and public tender disqualifications. Every single 3D element and metadata field is mathematically validated against strict ISO 19650 and UNI 11337 mandates before any final database commit is executed.

### Non-Disruptive Integration

Maximize the ROI of your existing software stack. Our headless infrastructure fuses directly with native Autodesk Revit and Navisworks APIs, executing algorithmic commands flawlessly without forcing your engineers to learn entirely new design platforms.

// SYSTEMATIC EXECUTION ARCHITECTURE

## The Execution Architecture.

How pyBIM translates text-based contracts directly into executed Revit parameters. No generic AI advice; only deterministic code generation.

01

### Vectorized Requirement Parsing

We eliminate standard AI memory hallucinations. Your proprietary EIRs, BEPs, and strict ISO 19650 and UNI 11337 protocols are processed into high-dimensional vector embeddings (ChromaDB). This mathematically forces our engine to adhere exclusively to your project’s contractual constraints.

02

### Native Script Compilation

The isolated AI engine reads the indexed rules and writes targeted C# and Python logic specific to your active Revit database. It generates precise, executable API commands, completely bypassing the limitations and latency of visual scripting environments.

03

### Transaction-Safe Injection

Custom scripts are injected directly into Revit’s main thread via isolated API transactions (DB.Transaction). If any element violates an indexed constraint, the transaction instantly rolls back, guaranteeing that your model geometry is never compromised.

### // ENTERPRISE INTEGRATION TOPOLOGIES

## Scalable Integration Pathways.

Engineered to support every operational scale. From executing complex workloads for growing studios to deploying air-gapped infrastructure for tier-1 contractors, we guarantee absolute data sovereignty.

### Turnkey Project Execution

(For Agile & Growing Firms)

Delegate your complex modeling, clash coordination, and ISO 19650 audits directly to our internal engineering unit. We leverage our proprietary algorithms to deliver mathematically verified models at unprecedented speeds, instantly eliminating manual data entry for your local team.

### Cloud-Connected APIs

(For Mid-to-Large Enterprise)

Connect your existing Autodesk Revit environments directly to our processing servers via highly secure APIs. Empower your internal workforce to generate scripts and validate models autonomously, scaling your algorithmic capabilities with zero hardware CapEx.

### Air-Gapped Sovereign Edge

(For Tier-1 Government Contractors)

Engineered exclusively for firms handling classified public infrastructure. The entire pyBIM ecosystem—Local LLMs, Vector Databases, and execution kernels—is physically deployed onto your internal LAN, guaranteeing 100% data sovereignty and zero external routing.

Manual:Weeks of redundant coordination meetings.

pyBIM Exec:Instantaneous rule-based elimination.

Protocol:Programmatic parsing of Solibri/Navisworks databases to generate actionable, clash-free reports prior to any human auditing.

# Scale Your BIM Execution Through Code, Not Headcount.

## Operating from the engineering R&D hub of **Padua, Italy**, pyBIM is not a traditional modeling farm. We are an advanced engineering and software lab. We execute complex BIM projects, develop bespoke **C# & Python** automations, and deploy **Sovereign Edge AI** to guarantee **100% zero-error deliverables** and absolute **ISO 19650** compliance for Tier-1 European contractors.

### The Traditional "Modeling Farm"

#### The Problem:

Relying on brute-force manual labor for clash detection and data entry mathematically guarantees human error and sluggish delivery times.

#### The Margin Drain:

This inflates operational overhead and jeopardizes strict **UNI 11337 / ISO 19650** compliance during high-stakes public tenders.

### Tech-Enabled Execution & Code

#### The Solution:

Outsource your complex coordination to our specialized hub. We replace redundant human effort with custom **Revit APIs** and **Sovereign AI** infrastructure.

#### The ROI:

We reduce your model clash resolution time from days to seconds, ensuring zero data leakage and massive financial savings.

## The Evolution from Manual Coordination to Tech-Enabled Execution.

Phase 1

### The Operational Bottleneck

* **The Systemic Flaw:** Managing complex European infrastructure projects exposed a critical industry failure. Highly skilled engineers waste up to **40% of their billable hours** on repetitive data entry, parameter mapping, and manual quality control.
* **The Margin Drain:** Relying on brute-force human labor mathematically guarantees data errors during high-stakes B2B tenders, draining project budgets and jeopardizing **ISO 19650** compliance.

Phase 2

### The Algorithmic Shift

* **The Engineering Hub:** Operating from the tech hub of **Padua, Italy**, we transformed our methodology. We stopped scaling by traditional headcount and transitioned entirely to execution code.
* **Tech-Enabled Delivery:** By developing custom **C# and Python** APIs for Revit, we automated clash matrices and parameter audits. We now deliver complex BIM projects with an **80% reduction in turnaround time** and absolute zero-error precision.

Phase 3

### Sovereign Enterprise AI

* **Air-Gapped Infrastructure:** To handle massive metadata validation at an enterprise scale, we engineered proprietary **Edge AI** appliances deployed directly within our clients' corporate LANs.
* **Absolute Data Security:** Zero public cloud exposure. We guarantee strict data sovereignty and algorithmic certainty for the most demanding structural engineering firms in Europe.
